address: Waagdragerhof 198 (Pakhuis Wilhelmina), Amsterdam-Centrum (Veemkade, KNSM-eiland): 2004 block with an eleven-storey dark red brick residential tower over the retained arched brick warehouse Pakhuis Wilhelmina, whose tall arched windows carry the lettering PAK HUIS WIL HEL MINA
notes: Waagdragerhof 198 (BAG pand 0363100012118320, built 2004, 126 3DBAG wall surfaces, roof max 34.9 m): the Pakhuis Wilhelmina block, a long retained brick warehouse of two to three storeys with round-arched windows and orange brick arch bands, with a dark red brick tower block of eleven storeys with a glazed commercial ground standing behind and over it, with a grey-clad bridging volume at the top. Four walls are drawn from panoramas: the tower south front (w04-196, 2022-12-28), the tower west front (w03-286, 2025-06-16), the warehouse south front with five tall arched windows lettered PAK HUIS WIL HEL MINA (w05-196, 2025-06-16) and the warehouse north front (w01-16, 2022-09-06, a 100 m crop).
